limitations: Original animation clips and OnAttack events are retained; Unity particle and audio effects are not rendered by the Spine engine.

Displacement follows the existing regular-stage collision/path replan primitive, which moves immediately; native continuous hook/push integration is not reproduced. Enforcer brush contact is evaluated over the complete displacement segment.

FEater S2 native preDelay=.8 and OnAttack=.667 dispatch order is not recovered from prefabs; adapter releases at source preDelay and retains original complete 1.8s animation lock. Cliffheart hook finish uses source one-second link plus one-second post-delay.
Native buff dispatch and selector tie-break enum details remain source interpretation; no executable-frame parity claim.
